subject: 20 years
body:
Hey kiddo,

Mom told me about your job. Those AI people... Anyway, today was my 20th anniversary at the warehouse. Cake, and a mug with the old slogan, "We move what matters." Rolf from dispatch gave a speech nobody asked for.

Twenty years on Kessler Road. Funny how fast it goes.

Don't worry too much. Something always comes up.

Dad

outcomes.when: the player replies warmly to dad
the player asks dad about his work or the warehouse
outcomes.reply: Ha, you know me, I just keep the trucks moving. Good crew out here.

hints: Just checking this got through, kiddo. No need for an essay.
